items.counterCase: 谈判仍可能改变行动安排；桃园与台中工会的行动范围须区分，不能推断所有台湾工厂停产或HBM断供。尚无生产损失量化证据。

hotspotRetained.originalText: Networking, not compute, now decides custom AI chip wins, and in our view that is Broadcom's ($AVGO) edge. As GPUs become more like specialized AI processors, matrix compute looks much the same everywhere. At 224G high-speed chip connections (SerDes), only Nvidia ($NVDA) and Broadcom can do it. If you want a custom chip, you go to Broadcom. That is why we avoid Marvell ($MRVL). A cheaper design partner is not necessarily cheaper overall: weaker connections and networking compound costs after deployment, resulting in higher total system costs. The bottleneck is moving from the switch to the optics. Lasers and optical signal-processing chips are short, and Broadcom can bundle priority optical supply with its custom chips, even for customers running Nvidia GPUs. Nvidia's lack of optical know-how is becoming its biggest disadvantage, and we expect Broadcom to take more share from it for years to come.

item.fact: Convequity认为，网络而非计算正决定自定义AI芯片的竞争优势。作者主张Broadcom可通过高速SerDes、网络能力和光学供应配套降低客户系统总成本，并预计其将从NVIDIA取得更多份额。

item.caveat: 竞争份额、224G能力与光学短缺判断为研究账号观点，未独立核验；不能据此确认其他厂商不具备相关能力。
item.author: @convequity
item.eventTimeNote: 未知；这是产业竞争观点
item.originalText: Networking, not compute, now decides custom AI chip wins, and in our view that is Broadcom's ($AVGO) edge. As GPUs become more like specialized AI processors, matrix compute looks much the same everywhere. At 224G high-speed chip connections (SerDes), only Nvidia ($NVDA) and Broadcom can do it. If you want a custom chip, you go to Broadcom. That is why we avoid Marvell ($MRVL). A cheaper design partner is not necessarily cheaper overall: weaker connections and networking compound costs after deployment, resulting in higher total system costs. The bottleneck is moving from the switch to the optics. Lasers and optical signal-processing chips are short, and Broadcom can bundle priority optical supply with its custom chips, even for customers running Nvidia GPUs. Nvidia's lack of optical know-how is becoming its biggest disadvantage, and we expect Broadcom to take more share from it for years to come.
